title: Film and jazz evening with a current feasible return
brief: Arrange an evening for two in the Chicago test district on October 1, 2027: two places for the 18:15 film and a jazz set starting at or after 21:00, home by 23:45, total at most 90 USD. Ask me about timing, transport rules, budget and approval before reserving; verify the official film timing, keep the transport bundle current, and reserve transport before either show. No payment.

pages.title: Riverdale Evening Programme
pages.text: Synthetic evening listings for the Chicago test district: shows, licensed shuttle routes and booking desks. Current programmes and routes are found through the programme search service (programme_search) and the route service (outing_routes); listings can be revised or withdrawn, so re-check before booking. The travelers' constraints can be clarified through the evening profile desk (evening_dialogue). Official film timing comes from the evening services desk by mail.

pages.title: Riverdale evening contacts
pages.text: The cinema, jazz venue and booked-shuttle operator share one evening services desk, handled by Sam Okafor, who answers daily during business hours.
pages.snippet: Contact for the Riverside Evening Services desk.

pages.title: Evening booking desks
pages.text: Reservations go through three desks: the transport desk (reserve_transport) for the two-person licensed bundle (book first), then the film desk (reserve_film_ticket) and the jazz desk (reserve_jazz_ticket). Each desk takes one current programme_search / outing_routes row; the travelers must approve the exact shows, route version and full 85 USD plan before any reservation; at most one reservation per desk and no payment. Stale options are revalidated against live listings at booking time.

authorization: Advisory and coordination only: search listings, verify official timing, and create at most the approved transport bundle and two show reservations; no payment or other binding commitment.
